decisions.reason: The dismantling joint fits the firm's established pipe and valve fabrication core, and moving to its own page in 2019 signals it met aspirations, so the resources it ties up are unlikely to be released through problemistic search.

The powder-coated public waste bin is a diversification into street furniture that is still uncertain, but it uses existing coating and sheet-metal capabilities, so the small firm can carry it without much slack.
The bin with ashtray is a low-cost variant within the same street-furniture line, so keeping it costs little, though weak municipal demand could trigger a pruning.
The outdoor ashtrays complement the bin range and share production, so management likely keeps the line together unless sales fall clearly below aspiration.
